source: Vlaamse Belastingdienst simulator (belastingen.fenb.be) calibration, WIGB art. 97ter-sexies, Bruxelles Fiscalite tariff PDF, SPW Finances bareme 1 Jul 2025. See README.

provenance.note: Per-constant source and validity. Flemish road tax and BIV amounts reindex every 1 July. Since 2026-09-01 the amounts are no longer a single stale set: flanders.biv.indexWindows and flanders.roadTax.indexWindows carry one override set per indexation window, newest first, and the engine selects by the date the tax is assessed. Since 2026-09-07 the selection honours the until bound as well as the from bound, so an expired table is never served silently: past its until date the engine keeps computing but labels the figure stale and forces the input tier down, and after twelve months it withdraws the amounts. q is not part of the 1 July indexation, it moves on 1 January, so it has its own series in flanders.biv.qWindows. Every dated window in this file is asserted by test/window-expiry-check.mjs, which fails the build once today is past the earliest until. The block outside indexWindows is the 1 July 2025 window and is still live for anything assessed before 1 July 2026, which is why the two older harnesses keep asserting those amounts. Confidence low means the value was not confirmed against a primary source and may be wrong.

primarySources.vcf: Vlaamse Codex Fiscaliteit van 13 december 2013, consolidated text, codex.vlaanderen.be (document 1023499, consolidation date 2026-06-11)
primarySources.bericht: Jaarlijks bericht tot aanpassing van de verkeersbelasting en de BIV, VCF art. 2.2.4.0.3 en 2.3.4.1.4, published in the Belgisch Staatsblad in June of each year
primarySources.simulator: Vlaamse Belastingdienst simulator, belastingen.fenb.be, captured via browser (API is WAF blocked to scripts)
primarySources.comparisonSet: test/simulator-comparison-2026-09.json: 29 vehicles driven through the public simulator wizard by Pax on 2026-09-01, one variable isolated per case, plus 5 label only probes that pinned the NEDC/WLTP boundary to the day. Asserted by test/simulator-comparison-harness.mjs --strict on every build.

flanders.biv.qWindows[2026-01-01].q.ref: art. 2.3.4.1.2/1, tweede lid, 3: q = 1,07 in 2021, +0,035 per year, so 1,245 in 2026. Applies to the WLTP branch ONLY, that is first registration from 01/01/2021. Below that date the numerator is CO2 x f + nedcCo2Offset and q does not appear at all.
flanders.biv.qWindows[2026-01-01].q.status: Moved out of the base block into flanders.biv.qWindows on 2026-09-07. It was the only dated constant sitting outside the window structure, so it would have gone stale on 1 January 2027 with nothing in the code able to notice.

flanders.biv.nedcCo2Offset.ref: The simulator asks for the NEDC CO2 value below first registration 01/01/2021 and the WLTP value from that date, and the numerator differs by branch: CO2 x f x q on WLTP, CO2 x f + 63,00 on NEDC. Inverting the sixth power on the official pre correction figures gives a constant additive 63,00 at 95, 130, 148 and 200 g (implied numerators 158, 193, 211, 263). The additive sits AFTER the fuel factor: on NEDC-LPG, f = 0,88 applied to (CO2 + 63) gives a core term of 487,00 while applied to the CO2 alone it gives 632,89, and the official figure is 632,89. Reproduces AGE-7Y, AGE-8Y, AGE-16Y, NEDC-095, NEDC-130, NEDC-200, NEDC-PET and NEDC-LPG. Before this branch existed the engine under quoted every pre 2021 car, mean +97,63 percent and worst +235,9 percent on the BIV.
flanders.biv.nedcCo2Offset.status: Measured and reproducible on 8 independent official rows. The STATUTORY NAMING is the weak part: the consolidated VCF text for art. 2.3.4.1.2/1 that sets the 63,00 could not be retrieved, so the article reference is not yet citable and the value is likely to move at the next annual adjustment. Do not remove this branch on the strength of a trade press formula: that is exactly the failure this fixed.

flanders.biv.sootFilterRule.ref: A diesel below Euro 5 is asked in the wizard whether a soot filter is fitted (Beschikt uw voertuig over een roetfilter). With a filter the car is billed on the Euro 5 column of BOTH the BIV air component and the road tax eco base, without one on its own euronorm column. Official EURO4-DPF BIV 1001,19 and road tax 417,05 against EURO4-NODPF 1011,87 and 445,03. The Euro 5 diesel air component derived from the statutory base, 636,20, equals the measured filter figure to the cent, which is what identifies the rule as a column switch rather than a separate discount.
flanders.biv.sootFilterRule.status: Measured at Euro 4 only. The same column switch is ASSUMED for Euro 0 to 3 and is not observed. No car ad exposes a soot filter field, so vehicle.sootFilter is normally null: the engine then bills the dearer no filter column, says so in its assumptions and lowers its confidence rather than defaulting silently. See openIssues.

flanders.biv.fuelFactor.ref: art. 2.3.4.1.2/1, tweede lid, 2: lpg 0,88, aardgas 0,93, aardgas+benzine 0,744, andere 1

flanders.biv.ageCorrection.ref: art. 2.3.4.1.2/1, tweede lid, 5. Percentage table set by decree, not indexed, unchanged since 2021-01-01

flanders.biv.airComponent.ref: VCF base amounts at 1 July 2015 (diesel euro 6 454,07, benzine euro 6 20,61) times the indexation coefficient. The values in the base block equal base times 1,3307, the 1 July 2025 coefficient.
flanders.biv.airComponent.status: Current for its own window, no longer drifted: the 1 July 2026 set now lives in indexWindows and the engine picks by assessment date.

flanders.biv.indexCoefficient.ref: 1 July 2026 indexation coefficient, up from 1,3307. Confirmed twice independently and to the cent: the statutory ceiling base 10.497,70 x 1,3850 = 14.539,31, which is exactly what case CO2-250 returned on hitting the cap, and the diesel Euro 6 base 454,07 x 1,3850 = 628,89, which is the air component implied by five separate official rows. The ceiling reading pins the coefficient to seven digits.
flanders.biv.indexCoefficient.status: Derived from the simulator rather than read from the bericht, because the 1 July 2026 Belgisch Staatsblad bericht is still not retrievable. Two independent confirmations make it safe to use.

flanders.biv.indexWindows[2026-07-01].ai.ref: Statutory 1 July 2015 bases times 1,3850. Diesel Euro 6 628,89, Euro 5 636,20 and Euro 4 646,88 and petrol Euro 6 28,54 are each confirmed against an official row to the cent. All other cells are derived by the same base times coefficient route and are NOT individually observed. Note the derivation must go through the rounded statutory base, not through the stored 2025 amount: petrol Euro 6 is 20,61 x 1,3850 = 28,54, whereas rescaling 27,43 directly gives 28,55 and is one cent wrong.

flanders.biv.min.ref: VCF art. 2.3.4.1.3 base 41,99 indexed. 55,88 is the confirmed 1 July 2025 figure. The 1 July 2026 figure is 41,99 x 1,3850 = 58,16 and lives in indexWindows.
flanders.biv.min.status: The 2026 value is derived from the confirmed coefficient, not observed: no case in the 29 case set is cheap enough to hit the floor.

flanders.biv.max.ref: VCF art. 2.3.4.1.3 base 10.497,70 indexed. 13.969,29 is the confirmed 1 July 2025 figure (previous year 13.694,25). Corrected on 2026-09-01 from a placeholder 10000, which under-reported BIV for any vehicle above roughly 226 g CO2/km. The 1 July 2026 ceiling is 10.497,70 x 1,3850 = 14.539,31, read directly off the simulator in case CO2-250, and lives in indexWindows. It supersedes the 13.969,29 set earlier the same day from the codex: 13.969,29 was right for its window and wrong for anything assessed from 1 July 2026.
flanders.biv.max.status: Both windows now observed. The 2026 ceiling is a direct simulator reading, the strongest evidence in the whole table.

flanders.biv.evFlat.ref: art. 2.3.4.1.1, tweede lid: 61,50 euro for electric or hydrogen vehicles first registered after 31 December 2025. Decree amount, not indexed.

flanders.roadTax.evFlat.ref: VCF art. 2.2.4.0.1, par. 9 sets 93,60 euro for electric or hydrogen vehicles registered after 31 December 2025, indexed and increased by the 10 percent opdeciemen. Case FUEL-EV returns 107,16 from the official simulator for the 1 July 2026 window. That replaces the 107,18 taken from motoring and fleet outlets earlier the same day: two cents, but it swaps a secondary source for a primary one. The 1 July 2025 window keeps 107,18 in the base block because that is what the 19 row road tax harness captured for a January 2026 assessment.
flanders.roadTax.evFlat.status: Primary source. Simulator reading, not trade press.

flanders.roadTax.nedcCo2OffsetGram.ref: On the NEDC branch the road tax is computed on CO2 + 27 g. A pure gram offset, not a coefficient, and a DIFFERENT correction from the BIV numerator: 148 g NEDC behaves like 169,48 g WLTP for the BIV and like 175 g WLTP here. Resolves to exactly 27,00 at every one of eight independent observations, across 95, 130, 148 and 200 g, diesel, petrol and LPG, at 9 and 15 fiscal PK. There is no single cycle conversion that satisfies both taxes, which is why chasing one number on one car never converged.
flanders.roadTax.nedcCo2OffsetGram.status: Measured. Statutory naming not retrievable, same gap as flanders.biv.nedcCo2Offset. The 35 g CO2 floor is applied AFTER the offset, which is an ordering no case in the set exercises.

flanders.roadTax.indexFactor.ref: 1 July 2026 road tax index, read straight off the reference cell: petrol Euro 6 at 130 g and 9 fiscal PK moved from 284,20 to 295,81. Every derived 2026 cell is the 1 July 2025 value times this factor. Slightly tighter than the 1,04089 estimated from the raw error spread, because the reference cell is an exact ratio of two official readings.

flanders.roadTax.min.ref: Confirmed 1 July 2025 minimumbelasting 53,23 plus 10 percent opdeciemen = 58,55. The 2026 window carries 60,94, that figure times the index factor.
flanders.roadTax.min.status: The 2026 value is derived, not observed: no case in the 29 case set is cheap enough to hit the floor.

flanders.roadTax.oldtimerFlat.ref: Confirmed 1 July 2025 oldtimer forfait (down from 103,35). The 2026 window carries 99,76, that figure times the index factor.
flanders.roadTax.oldtimerFlat.status: The 2026 value is derived, not observed. No oldtimer case was captured.

flanders.roadTax.pkBareme.ref: Scale shape. The formula divides R(PK) by referenceDenominator, so the absolute level cancels and only the ratios matter. Stored values equal the official 1 July 2025 PK scale (4 PK 93,60 up to 20 PK 2.394,96) divided by a constant 1,1464, so the ratios are correct even though the levels are not published amounts.
flanders.roadTax.pkBareme.status: Scale-free, so indexation drift does not affect output. Do not read these as euro amounts.

flanders.roadTax.indexWindows[2026-07-01.ref: In this window the cells ARE readable amounts: referenceDenominator equals ecoBaseAt130.petrol.6, so each cell is the road tax for a petrol Euro 6 130 g car at that fiscal PK. The 4, 7, 9, 11, 15 and 20 PK cells are direct official readings (85,00, 200,87, 295,81, 444,97, 852,91, 2174,33) from cases PK-04 to PK-20 and FUEL-PET. The other eleven cells are the 2025 value times the index factor and are derived, not observed. The measured cells do not sit on a single clean multiple of the 2025 scale, ratios run from 1,04062 to 1,04116, because the official rounds its own PK cell and then rounds again after the eco modulation.

flanders.roadTax.ecoBaseAt130.ref: Fitted to 19 simulator rows to the cent. Diesel euro 0 to 3 rows are extrapolated and untested.
flanders.roadTax.ecoBaseAt130.status: Current for its own window. The diesel Euro 4 cell 418,60 is now known to be WRONG in substance, not just stale: it is an untested extrapolation that sits between the two real answers, 417,05 with a soot filter and 445,03 without, because the engine never asked the filter question. It is left untouched here only because the 19 row harness captured it and re-fitting it would need a 1 July 2025 window capture that cannot be taken any more.

flanders.roadTax.indexWindows[2026-07-01.ref: diesel.5 417,05 and diesel.4 445,03 are direct official readings from EURO4-DPF and EURO4-NODPF, which also re-fit the Euro 4 cell that was previously extrapolated. diesel.6 is 407,7115, a FITTED coefficient carried to four decimals on purpose: the official diesel to petrol ratio at 130 g is 1,3783543 at 9 fiscal PK and 1,3782229 at 15 PK, so no two decimal amount reproduces both and the factorisation must split the difference. The value is a least squares fit over ten official rows and lands nine of them to the cent, leaving FUEL-DIE two cents low. Every petrol cell and diesel Euro 0 to 3 is the 2025 value times the index factor and is derived, not observed.

1,07515 times the index factor, then fitted against the CO2 sweep. Reproduces the diesel curve at 95, 130, 148, 200 and 250 g and the NEDC equivalents at 122, 157, 175 and 227 g, all to the cent, plus NEDC-PET at 9 fiscal PK.

flanders.roadTax.lpg.status: Current for its own window, bands beyond 13 PK still extrapolated.

flanders.roadTax.indexWindows[2026-07-01.ref: reduction 152,33 is measured, not indexed from 146,26: the index route gives 152,24 and misses by nine cents. 152,33 reproduces both FUEL-LPG (base 143,48) and NEDC-LPG (base 173,70) exactly, which also cross checks the NEDC gram offset on a second fuel. The accijnscompenserende belasting is NOT indexed and stays at 148,68; bands beyond 13 PK remain extrapolated.

inference.co2CycleByFirstReg.ref: Boundary moved from 2018-09 to 2021-01 on 2026-09-01. Pinned to the day by walking the wizard to the CO2 question at 01/01/2020, 01/07/2020, 01/10/2020, 31/12/2020 and 01/01/2021 and reading whether the label says NEDC or WLTP, with no calculation submitted. The old 2018-09 boundary was the EU type approval switch date, which is a different thing from the date the Flemish simulator changes which figure it asks for. This table no longer only tints a confidence label: it now selects the tax BRANCH, so a wrong boundary here moves money.

brussels.tmc.status: Not in scope of the 2026-09-01 audit. Treat as unverified.

brussels.roadTax.status: Not in scope of the 2026-09-01 audit. Treat as unverified.

wallonia.tmc.status: Not in scope of the 2026-09-01 audit. Treat as unverified.

wallonia.roadTax.evFlat.ref: This is the Flemish figure copied across. Wallonia operates a separate reduced forfait and no Walloon source was found for it.
wallonia.roadTax.evFlat.status: SUSPECT. Deliberately left unchanged on 2026-09-01 because no Walloon source could be found. Do not assume it tracks the Flemish amount.

annualScale.status: Flagged low confidence since 2026-07. Not in scope of the 2026-09-01 audit.

openIssues: RESOLVED 2026-09-01. The 148 g diesel that computed to 419,67 against an official 726,22 was the missing NEDC branch, not the age correction. The engine now returns 726,22. See flanders.biv.nedcCo2Offset.

RESOLVED 2026-09-01. The 1 July 2026 indexation is taken: BIV coefficient 1,3850, road tax factor 1,0408515, both derived from the simulator rather than from the bericht, which is still not retrievable. Nothing is marked DRIFTED any more, but every 2026 cell flagged derived in the entries above is arithmetic on a 2025 amount, not an observation.

The statutory articles that set the NEDC additive 63,00 and the NEDC road tax gram offset 27 could not be retrieved. Both are measured and reproducible on eight official rows each, but neither is citable to a decree yet and both are likely to move at the next annual adjustment. Retrieve the consolidated VCF text for art. 2.3.4.1.2/1 and the matching road tax article, then fill in the ref fields.

No UI input exists for the soot filter. The engine accepts vehicle.sootFilter, but nothing sets it: neither the AutoScout24 nor the mobile.de normaliser produces the field, and neither site exposes it as a structured attribute, at best as free text in an equipment list. For a diesel below Euro 5 the engine therefore bills the dearer no filter column, states that in its assumptions and lowers its confidence. Scoping it properly needs either a user toggle in the popup or a free text scan for roetfilter / Partikelfilter / filtre a particules, which is a separate task.

Two residuals of one cent survive on the BIV and cannot be closed by any choice of air component. The constraint intervals implied by the 13 official diesel Euro 6 rows have an EMPTY intersection: AGE-1Y requires the component to be at most 628,8885 and NEDC-200 requires at least 628,8926. The simulator therefore rounds internally in a way the formula does not expose. 628,89 sits inside 11 of the 13 intervals and misses the other two by well under a cent. Do not tune this constant to chase either row: it would break the other.
The 27 g NEDC road tax offset is applied before the 35 g CO2 floor. No captured case exercises a pre 2021 car below 35 g, so the ordering is a choice, not a measurement.

Brussels and Wallonia remain unverified. Their simulators were not queried. Note that moving the CO2 cycle boundary to 2021-01 also changes the Walloon TMC divisor for cars first registered between September 2018 and December 2020, from the WLTP divisor 136 to the NEDC divisor 115. That follows the same registration date logic, but it is untested against any Walloon source.

scope.note: v1 ships Flanders only. Brussels and Wallonia are encoded but have never been round tripped against an official source: brussels.tmc, brussels.roadTax and wallonia.tmc all carry confidence low in provenance, and wallonia.roadTax.evFlat is marked SUSPECT because it is the Flemish figure copied across. Rendering those in the same typography as a Flemish figure checked against 29 official simulator runs claims more than the evidence supports. Any region absent from validatedRegions returns a not-validated descriptor instead of an amount, and the badge points the user at that region's own official simulator. To bring a region back, validate it the way Flanders was validated and add it to this list.
scope.reviewedBy: Lex, Proxem AI, pre-publication legal review 2026-09-06

ageCorrection.source: VCF art. 2.3.4.1.2/1, tweede lid, 5 (LC table: 100/90/80/70/60/50/40/30/20/10 per completed year, floor 10 percent from 96 full months). Verified against the consolidated Vlaamse Codex Fiscaliteit on 2026-09-01. This is a percentage table set by decree, it is NOT indexed. Do not replace it with a decelerating curve: the 100/90/80/70/60/54/48/42 variant circulating in the motoring press is not the statutory table.

qWindows.note: q for calendar year 2026. VCF art. 2.3.4.1.2/1, tweede lid, 3: q = 1,07 in 2021 and rises 0,035 per calendar year. Confirmed against the 29 case official simulator set on 2026-09-01. q sits inside a term raised to the sixth power, so a 2,8 percent error in q is roughly 18 percent on the CO2 component, and it hits the WLTP branch, which is every car first registered from 01/01/2021. Do NOT compute the next value programmatically from a start year: the escalator can be stopped by decree and a formula that keeps climbing on its own is a silent wrong answer by design. Add the 2027 window here once the value is confirmed.

indexWindows.note: 1 July 2026 indexation. Coefficient 1.3850 (was 1.3307), confirmed twice over: the statutory ceiling base 10.497,70 x 1,3850 = 14.539,31, which is exactly what the simulator returned when case CO2-250 hit the cap, and the diesel Euro 6 base 454,07 x 1,3850 = 628,89, which is exactly the air component implied by five independent official rows. Air components are the 1 July 2015 statutory bases times the coefficient; diesel Euro 6, Euro 5 and Euro 4 are additionally confirmed against the simulator to the cent, the rest are derived the same way and not individually observed.

1 July 2026 indexation, factor 1,0408515 read straight off the reference cell (petrol Euro 6 130 g at 9 fiscal PK moved from 284,20 to 295,81). pkBareme at 4, 7, 9, 11, 15 and 20 PK, ecoBaseAt130 diesel Euro 5 and Euro 4, the LPG reduction and evFlat are official simulator readings; every other cell is the 1 July 2025 value times that factor and is derived, not observed. ecoBaseAt130.diesel.6 is a fitted coefficient carried to four decimals on purpose, see the provenance entry.

roadTax.reindexNote: Simulator-validated model (Pax section 12, all 19 rows to the cent). verkeersbelasting = (R(PK) / referenceDenominator) x U, floored at min. U = ecoBaseAt130(fuel,euro) + co2SlopePerGram x (max(co2FloorGram, co2) - 130). Diesel Euro 0-3 bases and LPG bands beyond 13 PK are extrapolated (untested). Amounts include opdeciemen and the 2026 index. The Flemish road-tax index refreshes every 1 July: re-scrape the simulator after the next indexation and update pkBareme, ecoBaseAt130, lpg and min.

roadTax.note: Fiscal-HP scale with 10 percent decime already included. EV/hydrogen exempt. Per-CV cents drift by indexation window.
Fiscal-HP scale with decimes. Diesel carries roughly +35 percent over the petrol base. EV pays a reduced forfait rather than full exemption.

annualScale.note: Representative 2025-2026 all-in fiscal-HP road-tax scale (10 percent decime included). Cents drift by region and indexation window. Flagged low confidence pending per-region bareme scrape.
